annotations.title: Apply an ordered batch of native design edits

description: Apply an ordered list of the individually exposed design tools to one design, updating state between edits and rendering one final preview. The tools[].tool enum lists every supported native name; each schema branch identifies its standalone counterpart and exact compatibility aliases. Operations are text/image addition, text edits, move/resize/rotate/align/duplicate/delete, crop, background removal, flip, original/background restoration, artwork generation and photoshoot. Use explicit elementId/areaId and native text/asset/placement/options objects; standalone workflow shorthand is not normalized inside a batch. May overwrite or delete content. Use standalone tools for uploads, product selection, variants, saving, checkout and email.

options.description: Existing arguments; advanced fields/aliases remain accepted. Supplied design patches can overwrite session content; preview/rendering can fetch public image URLs in those designs. Catalogue/session results include the full designArgumentSchema.

tools.description: Ordered native edits with tool, areaId/elementId and text/asset/placement/options objects. Flip uses item.options.direction; generate_artwork uses item.options.prompt (or value), plus optional singleResult/imageCount there. Updated design feeds the next item; one final preview. Use standalone tools for workflow shortcuts such as widthCm, uploads, variants, saving or checkout.

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: add_text. Add a new text object using native text options.
anyOf.title: add_text

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: update_text. Edit the selected text object using native text or element fields.
anyOf.title: update_text

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: add_image. Add artwork; add_asset is the existing name for the same native operation.
anyOf.title: add_image

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: move_element. Edit the selected element's placement or supplied element/text/asset properties. update_element uses exactly the same native editor as move_element, resize_element, rotate_element and align_element.
anyOf.title: move_element

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: resize_element. Change the selected element's dimensions with native placement or element fields.
anyOf.title: resize_element

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: rotate_element. Change the selected element's rotation with native placement or element fields.
anyOf.title: rotate_element

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: align_element. Change the selected element's position with explicit native placement coordinates.
anyOf.title: align_element

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: duplicate_element. Duplicate the selected element.
anyOf.title: duplicate_element

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: delete_element. Delete the selected element.
anyOf.title: delete_element

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: crop_image. Crop the selected image. These compatibility names all use the native crop operation and its supplied crop fractions.
anyOf.title: crop_image

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: remove_background. Remove an image background. Preserve-box names set preserveImageBox/preserveReplacementBox/fitInsidePreviousBox. Colour-key/solid/shirt-colour names apply an already processed options.replacementUrl; the standalone remove_background tool also supports the colour_key method. These are background-removal modes, not additional unrelated operations.
anyOf.title: remove_background

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: flip_image. Flip the selected image. flip_image uses options.direction; horizontal/vertical compatibility names select that direction.
anyOf.title: flip_image

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: restore_original_image. Recover the retained original upload for the exact element while preserving valid crop/flip modifiers and placement.
anyOf.title: restore_original_image

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: restore_background. Restore the current original image source, disable background removal and clear image modifiers while preserving placement.
anyOf.title: restore_background

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: generate_artwork. Generate artwork from options.prompt or value, using the existing allowance.
anyOf.title: generate_artwork

anyOf.description: Standalone tool: ai_photoshoot. Create an illustrative AI photoshoot; live_ai_photoshoot names the same native operation.
anyOf.title: ai_photoshoot

asset.description: Preserve the complete uploaded asset object returned by the tool.

crop.description: Fractions removed from each image edge; omitted sides remain zero.

element.description: Existing AgenticDesignToolRequest.element patch for the selected element, including text/style, image source and placement fields. Preserve unrelated returned element fields.

options.description: Native image options: flip direction=horizontal|vertical; native generation prompt, mode, singleResult, imageCount. This object is public options.options.

placement.description: x/y are normalized centres. coordinateSpace=print_area uses garment print bounds; otherwise stage. width/height use stage unless dimensionSpace=print_area.

text.description: Native text object, e.g. {text:'Hello',fontFamily:'...',fontSize:40,fill:'#ffffff'}. Use the standalone add_text/update_text tool for string shorthand.

tool.description: Select one of these finite native operations or compatibility names. Every operation has an independently exposed tool identified in its schema branch. Checkout, designkey, load and select_product do not run in this batch.

requestId.description: Generate a UUID for a new action. Reuse it only for retrying/polling that same action and payload. A new user edit needs a new UUID.

sessionToken.description: The private expiring capability returned by start_design_session. Do not publish it.

subject.description: The exact subject returned by start_design_session.
